verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill collection with an install path: a community user describes a 'git-clone-and-copy install model', and the docs mention global vs vendored installs plus an upgrade skill. However, no evidence shows a single documented one-liner, CLI, or marketplace command, or that skills activate automatically in the next session. missing for 10: a documented one-command install (package manager, CLI, or in-agent marketplace), evidence that skills are active in the next session after install, independent hands-on corroboration of the install flow
